text:
Your competitor with 180 Google reviews isn't better than you. They just ask every single customer.

Most businesses ask for reviews "sometimes". So they get 2 a month, and the shop with more reviews gets the call.

A review system that runs on its own:
1. Get your direct review link: Google Business Profile → "Ask for reviews" → copy link
2. Send it at the happiest moment: right after delivery, the haircut, the result. Not a week later.
3. Use one ready message:
"Hi [Name], thank you for choosing us today 🙏 If you liked the service, could you leave a 30-second review? It helps a small business like ours a lot: [link]"
4. Reply to every review within 24 hours, good or bad. Google shows that to the next customer.

10 customers a week × 40% who actually review = 4 new reviews a week. ~200 in a year.

Copy the message above and send it to your last 5 customers today.
